The '''Harron sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. When the Empire took control, [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[line squad]]s on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the Harron sector were gradually re-equipped with [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blasters]].
